hsbc: Three upper storeys behind recessed colonnade
Attic storey with projecting stone cornice
Central square drum and curved dome with lantern/finial
OSM footprint contains courtyard, preserved as a roof opening
Separate basement/storefront and low mezzanine window rows in each wing; checked against the 2025 photograph
russo: Three wide central bays and two narrower side bays
Two freestanding Ionic columns between central windows
Lower arches with sculptured spandrels; upper large rectangular windows
Side arched windows beneath triangular pediments
Large dentil cornice and sculpted parapet

estimated_not_surveyed: All vertical dimensions until a trustworthy measured source is available
Window aperture sizing and reveal depth 0.57m / wall thickness 0.62m
Side/rear window spacing not fully documented by these frontal photographs
Dome curvature and sculptural scroll relief profiles
modeling_policy: Actual masonry apertures, jambs, soffits, recessed glazing and freestanding columns; no opaque solid facade behind windows; geometry relief rather than photograph pasted to a box.
current_vs_original: HSBC overall composition follows present 2025 photograph; the 1920 original elevation is supplementary and is not treated as exact current ornament.
font: Subset of Noto Serif CJK SC, renamed BundInscriptionSubset; SIL Open Font License in assets/Noto-font-license.txt. Used for converted raised facade lettering.
